alt: 登山者用木杖試探下一塊踏腳石，小心跨越淺溪。
scene_prompt: A cautious hiker crosses a shallow rocky stream on broad stepping stones, carefully tests the next stone with a wooden walking stick before placing a foot and keeps a secure balanced stance on the current stone. A companion waits safely on the bank. Clear deliberate progress with precautions at every step, no dangerous drop or stunt.
